d: Everything that lets us grow begins with something that once held us steady. The people who loved us, the lessons we were given, the places that shaped us, all of it becomes the ground we stand on. But we were never meant to stay in one place forever. At some point we feel the pull to go beyond what we know and find our own way. Holding on and letting go can feel like opposites, yet it is that strong foundation that gives us the courage to move on.
